generation_purpose: No generation this revision; prior comparison and icon provenance retained

line_semantics.black: solid information, release requests, audit evidence, and trace records

fill_semantics: Flat pale fills match component and region function; never verdict or focus
policy_choice: Each reservoir chooses exactly one policy: user operating rules or a checked LLM proposal.

responsibilities.Rule-based operation: Selectable user operating rules produce a requested release.
responsibilities.LLM modules: Prompt, language model, operation proposal, and response checks form the alternative policy.
responsibilities.Native HydroCNHS: Provides GWLF/ABCD rainfall-runoff, Lohmann routing, and the native Dam API.
responsibilities.Reservoir operation: HydroOpsLM adds storage balance, release, and spill through the native Dam API.
responsibilities.Operation audit: Records configured decision criteria before physical storage, release, and spill calculations; it is not a PASS gate.
responsibilities.Trace records: Binds policy records and decision-audit verdicts to implemented release, storage, and spill after physical execution.
responsibilities.Available information: Configurable per-agent selection of causally available simulation values and external data; no same-step downstream simulation values.
responsibilities.External records: Optional observed river conditions, demands, forecasts, targets and other supplied quantities with units and availability.

record_flow: The shared operation interface supplies the release request to decision audit before physics. Trace later binds its verdict to committed physical execution; LLM proposal and checker records are retained separately.
